title: Barbara Love Doll
descriptionHtml:
Descubre el realismo elevado al máximo con nuestras muñecas y muñecos de cuerpo completo, diseñados para ofrecer una experiencia intensa, realista y totalmente personalizada. Estos son los detalles de este juguete en concreto: Weight: 33kg
Height: 159cm
Breast-waist-hip: 80*56*82cm
Feet size: 21cm
Vagina depth: 18cm
Anus depth: 18cm
Oral depth: 15cm
Cleaning : after each use, wash with lukewarm soapy water and a utensil cleaner. Allow to dry completely, then after a thorough wipe down, also apply a regenerating talcum powder, this will maintain the elasticity of the fabric. A water-based lubricant is recommended.
